description: This file sets up the entry point for a React application, importing necessary libraries, stylesheets, and the main App component. It initializes the React DOM root and renders the App component within StrictMode for improved error detection.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React application into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM element associated with the root.
